text: The Daric Investment Group's founder, owner and chairman of the board is Mohammad Reza Zonouzi Motlagh, as stated on the group's own website.
short: Mohammad Reza Zonouzi Motlagh is the founder, owner and chairman of the Daric Investment Group.

source.quote: The Owner and Founder Of The Daric Investment Group. Mohammad Reza Zonouzi Motlagh
